description: Synthetic historical customer DM and seller-reply examples for development and demos.

exchanges.text: Hi! are the Moonlit Pearl Hoops real pearls?
exchanges.seller_reply: Hi! Yes, they use freshwater pearls, so each one has its own lovely little shape ✨

exchanges.text: Do you have Terracotta Sun Studs in cream?
exchanges.seller_reply: We do have the cream pair listed. I can check today's availability for you before you place an order 🌼

exchanges.text: Can I get the indigo threader earrings by Friday?
exchanges.seller_reply: I’m sorry, the Indigo Threaders are sold out at the moment. I can let you know when they’re back 💙

exchanges.text: price for the Gulabi drops?
exchanges.seller_reply: The Gulabi Meenakari Drops are ₹1,899, handmade with enamel details 🌸

exchanges.text: Will Riverstone cuff fit a small wrist?
exchanges.seller_reply: It comes in Small and Medium and is gently adjustable. Share your wrist measurement and I’ll help you choose 💚

exchanges.text: Can you do 25 Wildflower necklaces for bridesmaids?
exchanges.seller_reply: That sounds beautiful! For a bulk order of 25, I’ll check with the maker on timing and availability and get back to you 🌼

exchanges.text: Your price is too much. give me 50% off
exchanges.seller_reply: I understand wanting to find the right price. Our pieces are made in small batches, so I can’t offer that discount, but I’m happy to suggest something within your budget 🤍

exchanges.text: Is the kundan choker available??
exchanges.seller_reply: Let me check the current stock for you. The Kundan Garden Choker is a small-batch piece, and I don’t want to promise before confirming ✨

exchanges.text: I got my bracelet and one bead fell off. This is ridiculous
exchanges.seller_reply: I’m really sorry that happened. That’s not the experience we want you to have. Please send your order number and a photo, and I’ll arrange for the team to help 🤍

exchanges.text: Is this still available?
exchanges.seller_reply: Happy to check! Which piece are you asking about? You can send me its name or a screenshot 😊

exchanges.text: How long does shipping take to Pune?
exchanges.seller_reply: We usually dispatch in 2–3 working days; delivery time depends on the courier and your pin code. Share it and I can help estimate 🌿

exchanges.text: Can you make these earrings in silver instead?
exchanges.seller_reply: Thanks for asking! These are currently made in gold-tone brass. I can pass along your silver-finish request to our maker ✨

exchanges.text: Do the Everyday Huggies come in 10mm?
exchanges.seller_reply: They’re offered in both 10 mm and 12 mm. Tell me which finish you prefer and I’ll check availability for you 🤍

exchanges.text: I need 8 Daisy Chain bracelets urgently for tomorrow
exchanges.seller_reply: I’ll check with the team on stock and dispatch timing for eight pieces. I can’t promise tomorrow until we confirm both 🌼

exchanges.text: Are the Mitti beads heavy?
exchanges.seller_reply: They’re made from terracotta, but designed to feel light for everyday wear. Each bead is hand-painted, so little variations are part of the charm 🌾

exchanges.text: Can I return the necklace if I don't like it?
exchanges.seller_reply: I can help with the return policy. Please share your order number and I’ll have the team confirm the options for your purchase 🤍

exchanges.text: Is the ear cuff for pierced ears?
exchanges.seller_reply: No piercing needed for the Celestial Ear Cuff ✨ It gently sits on the outer ear.

exchanges.text: Do you have these in a larger bangle size?
exchanges.seller_reply: The Monsoon Glass Bangles come in 2.4, 2.6, and 2.8. If you share your usual bangle size, I can help check the closest fit 🌧️

exchanges.text: rose quartz lariat price?
exchanges.seller_reply: The Rose Quartz Lariat is ₹2,799, with a natural rose quartz drop in a soft blush tone 🌷

exchanges.text: Can I pay cash on delivery?
exchanges.seller_reply: Please share your delivery pin code and I’ll confirm which payment options are available for your location 😊

exchanges.text: I ordered last week and no update. scam page?
exchanges.seller_reply: I’m sorry you’ve been left waiting. Please DM your order number and I’ll ask our team to check the tracking right away 🤍

exchanges.text: Need two marigold jhumkas for a wedding this weekend
exchanges.seller_reply: I’ll check whether two pairs are available and whether delivery can reach you in time. What’s your pin code? 🌼

exchanges.text: Do you ship to Goa?
exchanges.seller_reply: We ship across India. Send your pin code and I can help with an estimated delivery window 🌿

exchanges.text: Can I get a custom name charm added to this?
exchanges.seller_reply: Custom pieces need a quick check with our maker. Tell me what you have in mind and I’ll pass the request along ✨

exchanges.text: Is the pearl necklace waterproof?
exchanges.seller_reply: We recommend keeping plated pieces and pearls away from water, perfume, and lotions to help them stay lovely longer 🤍

exchanges.text: I want 12 pairs of the sun studs for return gifts, any lower rate?
exchanges.seller_reply: Thanks for thinking of us for your return gifts! I’ll check bulk pricing and stock for 12 pairs with the team and get back to you 🌼

exchanges.text: the clasp on my anklet broke after one day!!
exchanges.seller_reply: I’m so sorry about the clasp. Please send your order number and a clear photo; our team will look into a repair or next step with you 🤍

exchanges.text: Which earrings are under 1000?
exchanges.seller_reply: We have a few lovely options in that range. Tell me whether you prefer studs, hoops, or something without a piercing and I can narrow it down 😊

exchanges.text: Can you reserve the Riverstone cuff till tomorrow?
exchanges.seller_reply: I can check whether we can hold one for you. Which size would you like? 💚

exchanges.text: Thanks, got the huggies! love them
exchanges.seller_reply: That makes us so happy to hear! Thank you for choosing a little handmade piece from our studio 🤍
